title: LavaChicken (Extended ver.)
description: Replaces the current remixed lava chicken song to Jack Black's "Steve's Lava chicken Extended" track.
body:
If you're like me, and would much prefer to listen to the actual Lava chicken song through minecraft's music disc, then this is the resource pack for you! 

This resource pack simply replaces the current remixed lava chicken song to **Jack Black's "Steve's Lava chicken Extended"** track.

> _This resource pack may be updated with every version after 1.21.8, however times may fluctuate. Sorry!_
